definition: Polymorphism in computer science refers to the ability of a function or an object to take on many forms.
details: Polymorphism in computer science refers to the ability of a function or an object to take on many forms. It allows methods to do different things based on the object it is acting upon, essential for achieving abstraction and flexibility in object-oriented programming.
